'''Vincent Malik Edwards''' (born April 5, 1996) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Pioneros de Los Mochis]] of the [[CIBACOPA]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue Boilermakers]], and was drafted in the second round of the [[2018 NBA draft]].

==College career==
Edwards committed to [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]] from [[Middletown High School (Ohio)|Middletown High School]] in [[Middletown, Ohio]], choosing the Boilermakers over [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]].<ref>{{cite web| last = Doyle | first = Kevin | title = 2014 forward Vince Edwards commits to Purdue | work = [[NBCSports.com]] | date = September 15, 2013 | url = http://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2013/09/15/2014-forward-vince-edwards-commits-to-purdue/| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150908161552/http://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2013/09/15/2014-forward-vince-edwards-commits-to-purdue/ | archive-date = September 8, 2015 | access-date = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> The versatile [[small forward]] started beginning in his freshman season, earning [[Big Ten Conference]] freshman of the week honors three times.<ref name=clark/> As a sophomore, Edwards averaged 11.3 points and 5.4 rebounds per game and toyed with the NBA draft before deciding to return to Purdue.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Baird|first1=Nathan|title=Purdue's Edwards withdraws from NBA draft|url=http://www.jconline.com/story/sports/college/purdue/basketball/2016/05/24/purdues-edwards-withdraws-nba-draft/84800456/|access-date=January 16, 2018|work=The Journal & Courier|date=May 24, 2016}}</ref>

In his junior season, he averaged 12.6 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.6 assists per game and was named third-team [[List of All-Big Ten Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big Ten]].<ref name=clark>{{cite web| last = Clark | first = Dave | title = Middletown's Vincent Edwards named third-team all-Big Ten | work = [[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] | date = March 7, 2017 | url = http://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/high-school/ohio-high-school/2017/03/07/middletowns-vincent-edwards-named-third-team-all-big-ten/98846850/| access-date = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> He scored a career-high 26 points in a 69–64 win over [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]] on February 9, 2017.<ref>{{cite news |date=February 9, 2017 |title=No. 16 Purdue makes late charge to get past Hoosiers 69–64 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400914984 |access-date=March 3, 2023}}</ref> While Edwards was a key player for Purdue during the season, he tended to raise his level of play in the NCAA tournament for the Boilermakers.<ref>{{cite web| last = Osipoff | first = Michael | title = Purdue junior Vincent Edwards shines again on NCAA Tournament stage | work = [[Chicago Tribune]] | date = March 22, 2017 | url = http://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/post-tribune/sports/ct-ptb-mens-basketball-purdue-vincent-edwards-st-0323-20170322-story.html| access-date = August 25, 2017 }}</ref>

Following his junior season, Edwards declared for the [[2017 NBA draft]] without hiring an agent. He ultimately decided to return to Purdue for his senior year.<ref>{{cite web| last = Baird | first = Nathan | title = Purdue's Vincent Edwards returning for senior year | work = [[Journal & Courier]] | date = May 24, 2017 | url = http://www.jconline.com/story/sports/college/purdue/basketball/2017/05/24/purdues-vincent-edwards-returning-senior-year/102090706/| access-date = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> As a senior, Edwards averaged 14.6 points, 7.4 rebounds and 2.9 assists per game, shooting 47.6 percent from the floor and 39.8 percent from three-point range. He was a second-team All-Big Ten selection. He finished his Purdue career with 1,638 points, 779 rebounds and 403 assists and started the second-most games for a Boilermaker with 125.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Cassano|first1=Rick|title=College Insider: Purdue's Edwards wins cash with 3X3U national title|url=https://www.journal-news.com/sports/college-insider-purdue-edwards-wins-cash-with-3x3u-national-title/7T5DVcESwNjek2GcpKt2jJ/|access-date=April 17, 2018|work=Journal-News|date=April 2, 2018}}</ref>

==Professional career==

===Houston Rockets (2018–2019)===
On June 21, 2018, Edwards was selected by the [[Utah Jazz]] with the 52nd pick in the [[2018 NBA draft]]. He was subsequently traded to the [[Houston Rockets]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/rockets-acquire-two-players-2018-nba-draft|title=Rockets Acquire Two Players in 2018 NBA Draft|date=June 21, 2018|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc|access-date=June 21, 2018}}</ref> On July 5, 2018, the Rockets announced that they had signed Edwards via their [[Twitter]] account.<ref>{{cite web|title=Official: The Houston Rockets have signed @Gary11_Clark and @IB4T_12.|url=https://twitter.com/HoustonRockets/status/1014973683922694145|website=Houston Rockets on Twitter|access-date=July 5, 2018|date=July 5, 2018}}</ref> Edwards mainly competed for their [[G League]] affiliate, the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]], averaging 9.7 points and 5.3 rebounds per game on a team that won the G League championship.<ref name="hartman">{{cite news |last1=Hartman |first1=Marcus |title=Cleveland Cavaliers G League team acquires Middletown grad Vincent Edwards |url=https://www.journal-news.com/sports/cleveland-cavaliers-league-teams-acquires-middletown-grad-vincent-edwards/0wQg4CHuFAO0tfSsGjkY3O/ |access-date=February 18, 2020 |work=[[Journal-News]] |date=February 18, 2020}}</ref>

===Oklahoma City Blue (2019–2020)===
Edwards joined the [[Oklahoma City Blue]] in October 2019.<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Gee |first1=Erik |title=Oklahoma City Blue Release Training Camp Roster. |url=https://www.si.com/nba/thunder/news/oklahoma-city-blue-release-training-camp-roster/ |access-date=December 5, 2019 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=October 29, 2019}}</ref> On February 11, 2020, Edwards posted 35 points, 11 rebounds, two assists, two steals and two blocks in a 137–118 win over the [[Long Island Nets]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Vincent Edwards: Nabs big double-double |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/vincent-edwards-nabs-big-double-double/ |access-date=June 15, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=February 12, 2020}}</ref> He averaged 11.0 points and 5.3 rebounds per game in 29 games.<ref name="hartman"/>

===Canton Charge (2020)===
On February 16, 2020, the [[Canton Charge]] announced that they had acquired Edwards from the [[Oklahoma City Blue]] in exchange for [[Tyler Cook]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Charge Acquire Vincent Edwards|url=https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/charge-acquire-vincent-edwards|date=February 16, 2020|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 16, 2020|archive-date=February 18, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200218021602/https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/charge-acquire-vincent-edwards/|url-status=dead}}</ref> He averaged 3.4 points, 2.4 rebounds, and 1 assist per game for Canton.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Radov |first1=Joanna |title=Vincent Edwards in Review |url=https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/vincent-edwards-in-review/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=October 20, 2020 |date=September 16, 2020}}</ref>

===Return to the Blue (2021)===
On December 17, 2020, Edwards signed with the [[Sacramento Kings]],<ref>{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Kings Sign Vince Edwards To Camp Deal|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2020/12/kings-to-sign-vince-edwards-to-camp-deal.html|date=December 17, 2020|website=HoopsRumors.com|access-date=March 1, 2021}}</ref> but was waived two days later<ref>{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Kings Waive Vince Edwards|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2020/12/kings-waive-vince-edwards.html|date=December 19, 2020|website=HoopsRumors.com|access-date=March 1, 2021}}</ref> and signed back with the Blue on January 28, 2021.<ref>{{cite web|title=Oklahoma City Blue Announces 2020–21 Roster|url=https://oklahomacity.gleague.nba.com/news/oklahoma-city-blue-announces-2020-21-roster/|date=January 28, 2021|website=NBA.com|access-date=March 1, 2021}}</ref>

===Iowa Wolves (2021–2022)===
On October 15, 2021, Edwards signed with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Timberwolves Sign Vince Edwards|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/timberwolves-sign-vince-edwards|website=NBA.com|date=October 15, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}}</ref> only to be waived the next day.<ref>{{cite web|title=Timberwolves Waive Vince Edwards|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/timberwolves-waive-vince-edwards|website=NBA.com|date=October 16, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}}</ref> On October 26, he signed with the [[Iowa Wolves]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Iowa Wolves Announce Training Camp Roster and Finalize Coaching Staff|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/iowa-wolves-announce-training-camp-roster-and-finalize-coaching-staff/n-5758384|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 26, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}}</ref>

===Titanes del Distrito Nacional (2022)===
Edwards signed with the [[Titanes del Distrito Nacional]] in the Dominican National Basketball League ([[Liga Nacional de Baloncesto|LNB]]) for the 2022 season.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://momentodeportivord.com/vincent-edwards-refuerzo-de-titanes-del-distrito/ |title=Vincent Edwards refuerzo de Titanes del Distrito |language=es |trans-title=Vincent Edwards reinforces Titanes del Distrito |first=Hector Sr. |last=Garcia |work=MomentoDeportivoRD.com |date=June 1, 2022 |access-date=June 10, 2022}}</ref>

===BCM Gravelines (2022–2023)===
On July 9, 2022, he signed with [[BCM Gravelines-Dunkerque]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/vince-edwards-signs-with-bcm-gravelines-dunkerque/|title=Vince Edwards signs with BCM Gravelines-Dunkerque|work=Sportando |date=July 9, 2022|language=en|access-date=July 9, 2022 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }}</ref>

===Ironi Ness Ziona (2023)===
On August 9, 2023, he signed with [[Ironi Ness Ziona B.C.|Ironi Ness Ziona]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.eurobasket.com/France/news/823427/Vince-Edwards-(ex-Gravelines)-is-a-newcomer-at-INess-Ziona|title= Vince Edwards (ex Gravelines) is a newcomer at I.Ness Ziona|date=August 9, 2023|publisher=Eurobasket|language=En|access-date=August 17, 2023}}</ref>

===Mitteldeutscher BC (2023–2024)===
On November 12, 2023, he signed with [[Mitteldeutscher BC]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/vince-edwards-joins-syntainics-mbc/|title=Vince Edwards joins Syntainics MBC|work=Sportando |date=November 12, 2023|language=En|access-date=November 12, 2023 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }}</ref>

===Seoul Samsung Thunders (2024)===
On December 11, 2024, Edwards signed with [[Seoul Samsung Thunders]] of the [[Korean Basketball League]] to replace [[Kofi Cockburn]] until December 29.<ref>{{cite web |title=삼성, 일시 대체로 포워드 외국선수…1996년생 G리그+유럽 리그 거친 에드워즈 영입 |url=https://jumpball.co.kr/news/newsview.php?ncode=1065581187406971 |website=점프볼 |access-date=December 11, 2024 |date=December 11, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=삼성, 일시 대체 외국 선수로 NBA 경력자 에드워즈 영입... 11일 경기부터 바로 출전 가능 |url=https://www.rookie.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=104090 |website=Rookie |access-date=December 11, 2024 |date=December 11, 2024}}</ref>

==International career==
Edwards was a part of the Purdue team chosen to represent the United States in the [[2017 Summer Universiade]] in [[Taipei]], ROC.<ref>{{cite web| last = Neubert | first = Brian | title = Vincent Edwards showing signs of alpha potential for Purdue | work = [[Rivals.com]] | date = August 24, 2017 | url = https://purdue.rivals.com/news/vincent-edwards-showing-signs-of-alpha-potential-for-purdue| access-date = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> and they captured a silver medal.

==Personal life==
Edwards is the son of former [[Wright State Raiders men's basketball|Wright State]] star and [[NBA]] player [[Bill Edwards (basketball)|Bill Edwards]].<ref>{{cite web| last = Baird | first = Nathan | title = Purdue's Vince Edwards thankful for mother's lessons | work = [[Indianapolis Star]] | date = November 25, 2015| url = http://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/purdue/2015/11/25/purdues-vince-edwards-thankful-mothers-lessons/76398956/| access-date = August 25, 2017 }}</ref>
